content:
alex: Quick async standup — Greenwave rollout check-in. Canary started @ 11:02 PST. 50 instances, 5% traffic via feature flag. What I did: kicked off canary, ran smoke tests, verified model variant routing. Blockers: saw a transient 502 on /v1/infer for ~2m, suspected autoscaler churn. Today: keep canary at 5% for 2h, monitor logs/latency; ready to roll to 20% after 30m if stable.

maria: QA smoke pass on text-gen and embeddings for canary; one flaky test for streaming chunk order (test_stream_order). Repro steps below.

maria: ```bash
# repro (local):
curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/v1/infer -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"stream test","stream":true}' 
# check ordering in logs: kubectl logs -l app=greenwave-canary -c infer --tail=200 | grep stream_chunk
```

yana: Noted the 502 spike — saw pod restarts on pool-gpu-3 around 11:04. Investigating OOMs; CPU/GPU pressure peaked. Pushing a small autoscaler tweak to increase buffer. Will watch for 15m.

deploy-bot: Deployment greenwave-canary v2.3.1 -> prod-canary on pool-gpu-3 completed. Health checks: 98/100 passing. Rollback threshold: 3% errors over 5m.

kevin: Quick question — what's the exposure rule for the flag? Need to confirm enterprise tenants not in the cohort. Also what's the default fallback model if canary fails?

alex: Flag is org-scoped, cohort=beta only. We explicitly excluded tenants with tag:enterprise via the rollout rule. Default fallback is model v2.2 (stable). Heavy hitters still route to stable cluster. Check flag status: ```ldctl rollout status greenwave_flag --env=prod --cohort=beta```

dave: If we need to flip to 0% quickly: 
```bash
curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${FLAGS_TOKEN}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"flag":"greenwave_flag","pct":0}'
```
I can run this if alex yells. :call_me_hand:

maria: The streaming order flake happens under load >800rps. Canary at 5% only hit ~200rps so not repro yet. Plan: spin a load job against the canary pool (ab).

alex: Spinning load in ~2m: ```bash
k8s exec -it loadgen -- ab -n 100000 -c 200 https://canary.redwood/api/v1/infer```
Will post results. If errors >2% we abort and rollback.

yana: Autoscaler patch applied to pool-gpu-3, buffer increased from 2->4. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/greenwave (watching GPU utilization and pod restarts). PTAL.

sre-bot: Alert: error_rate_greenwave_canary exceeded 2% (11:07-11:09). Current: 2.8%. Investigation triggered.

alex: Saw the alert — looks correlated with the pod restarts. Holding on increasing rollout. If >3% sustained for 5m we trigger automated rollback per the policy.

maria: Load job finished — 100k requests at concurrency 200. Errors: 0.9% overall, no streaming-order flake reproduced. Logs snippet attached in thread.

alex: Good signal. I'll bump to 20% in 10m if no new alerts. Posting here when I start the increase. Thanks everyone for quick checks.

dave: I'll be oncall during the window, ping me on pager if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
